remarks: Nested alongside Fivemile river, this waterfront 3 bedroom 2.5 bath townhouse is a perfect fit for anyone looking for both a luxurious and comfortable setup close to the epicenter of New Canaan. The 2,279 sq. foot space boasts a wide, high-ceilinged living room with two-story windows, a fireplace, sleek hardwood floors and a Chef's kitchen! There's also a fully-finished basement as well as an easily accessible attic space. The two-car garage attached (unique among townhouses in the area) makes this a particularly attractive home for any active family. Enjoy New Canaan's award winning restaurants, brand new library, boutique shops. Play tennis, swim or just enjoy all the towns beautiful parks and playgrounds! Minutes from it all!
